storage: Tightly closed plastic container, away from acids; it absorbs carbon dioxide and water.

reactions.note: Reacts with acids to give a salt and water, releasing heat.
Gives coloured hydroxide precipitates with many metal ions, for example blue copper(II) hydroxide.

educational_notes: A 0.1 mol/L solution has a pH of about 13.
